title: TOE Block 59: resolve Regge infrared pseudo-constraint scaling
science: Block 59: finds the nonlinear Ward defect of the fixed Regge candidate scales as eta^2 k^3 — one momentum power softer than the target sourced graviton equation — and thereby restores fixed Regge as an emergent-infrared candidate rather than an exact microscopic first-class law. This reframing is the direction-setter for the subsequent mechanism arc and for treating microscopic exactness claims as dead.
